2608.20794.title: Knowing but Not Saying: Preventing Factual Access Failures in LLM SFT via Recall-Anchored Distillation
2608.20794.paper_summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can degrade factual behavior outside the target domain. This degradation is often described as catastrophic forgetting, yet open-ended factual failures do not necessarily imply that the underlying facts have been erased. In this work, we identify a more specific phenomenon, factual access failure: after domain SFT, models can still recognize or rank the correct answer under constrained evaluation, while failing to produce it in closed-book generation. Through benchmark-level comparisons, same-fact multiple-choice and generation probes, and failure-mode analysis, we show that SFT-induced factual degradation reflects both genuine wrong-answer generations and expression-level failures such as verbosity, formatting mismatch, and exact-match artifacts. To address this problem, we introduce Recall-Anchored Distillation (RAD), a base-anchored self-distillation objective that preserves out-of-distribution generation behavior by aligning the adapted model with the original base model's soft continuation distribution on unlabeled OOD text. RAD requires no gold OOD answers, external judges, or labeled factual data. Across three backbones fine-tuned on MedMCQA, RAD recovers a consistent portion of the lost OOD recall while preserving target-domain adaptation. Compared with replay on the same OOD text, RAD shows that the key preservation signal is the base model's soft distribution rather than additional text exposure alone.
2608.20794.paper_summary_zh: 監督式微調（SFT）可能會降低目標領域以外的事實行為。這種降級通常被描述為災難性遺忘，但開放式的事實失敗並不一定意味著底層事實已被抹去。在這項工作中，我們識別出一種更具體的現象，即事實訪問失敗：在領域 SFT 之後，模型仍然可以在受限評估下識別或排名正確答案，但在閉卷生成中卻無法產生它。通過基準級別的比較、相同事實的多選題和生成探測以及失敗模式分析，我們顯示 SFT 引起的事實降級反映了真正的錯誤答案生成和表達層級的失敗，例如冗長、格式不匹配和精確匹配伪影。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了基於回憶的蒸餾（RAD），這是一種基於基礎的自我蒸餾目標，通過將適應後的模型與原始基礎模型在未標記的 OOD 文本上的軟延續分佈對齊，來保留分佈外生成行為。RAD 不需要金標 OOD 答案、外部評審或標記的事實數據。在三個在 MedMCQA 上微調的基礎模型中，RAD 恢復了丟失的 OOD 回憶的一致部分，同時保留了目標領域的適應性。與在相同 OOD 文本上重播相比，RAD 顯示關鍵的保留信號是基礎模型的軟分佈，而不僅僅是額外的文本曝光。
